options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity WebServices Proxy or embedded REST API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity WebServices Proxy or embedded REST API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity WebServices Proxy or embedded REST API.

options.name: base_volume_name
options.description: The name of the base volume or thin volume to use as the base for the new snapshot group. If a snapshot group with an identical C(name) already exists but with a different base volume an error will be returned.

options.name: delete_limit
options.description: The automatic deletion indicator. If non-zero, the oldest snapshot image will be automatically deleted when creating a new snapshot image to keep the total number of snapshot images limited to the number specified. This value is overridden by the consistency group setting if this snapshot group is associated with a consistency group.

options.name: full_policy
options.description: The behavior on when the data repository becomes full. This value is overridden by consistency group setting if this snapshot group is associated with a consistency group

options.name: name
options.description: The name to give the snapshot group

options.name: repo_pct
options.description: The size of the repository in relation to the size of the base volume

options.name: rollback_priority
options.description: The importance of the rollback operation. This value is overridden by consistency group setting if this snapshot group is associated with a consistency group

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to ensure the group is present or absent.

options.name: storage_pool_name
options.description: The name of the storage pool on which to allocate the repository volume.

options.name: warning_threshold
options.description: The repository utilization warning threshold, as a percentage of the repository volume capacity.
